subject: general
question: For which of the following countries does cricketer Ben Stokes play?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Benjamin Andrew Stokes** is an English cricketer who plays for the England One Day International (ODI) and Twenty20 International (T20I) teams.
 
• He is also regarded as one of the best All-Rounders in world cricket and in the history of England.
 
• He was awarded the Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy for Best Cricketer of the Year by the International Cricket Council (ICC) in January 2020.
 
• He was also named as the Wisden Leading Cricketer in the World for 2019.
